settings.heading: Where are you based?
settings.row_content: We're in Hout Bay, Cape Town. You're welcome to visit the studio to view art in person or join a class — see our Contact page for directions.

settings.heading: Do I need experience to join a class?
settings.row_content: Not at all. Our classes and workshops run from complete-beginner level through to masterclasses, and our teachers meet you exactly where you are.

settings.heading: How do I book a class or workshop?
settings.row_content: Everything is booked online. Open any class, choose your session or the full term, and check out. You'll receive a confirmation by email.

settings.heading: Can I pay in instalments?
settings.row_content: For selected classes you can pay in two — a deposit now and the balance later. Where it's available, you'll see the option on the booking page.

settings.heading: Do you sell original art online?
settings.row_content: Yes. Browse and buy original works and limited-edition prints directly from our resident artists in the gallery.

settings.heading: Do you ship artworks?
settings.row_content: We ship nationwide, and internationally on request. Get in touch if you'd like a shipping quote before you buy.

settings.heading: Can I see the art in person before buying?
settings.row_content: Absolutely. Many works are on show at the studio — contact us to arrange a viewing.

settings.heading: Can I hire the studio?
settings.row_content: Yes — our space is available for creative hire. See the Studio Hire page or send us an enquiry.
